My foundation lies in a blend of Business Administration and Data Analytics. I bridge the gap between 'What if we could...' strategy sessions and 'Here's how it works' technical execution.

## Projects

### Neura-Q — AI Decision Framework
- Role: Business Solutions Architect
- Live: https://neuraq.netlify.app/
- GitHub: https://github.com/devisdev365/neura-q
- **Problem:** Users often treat ChatGPT like a 'magic wand,' providing zero context yet expecting expert-level results. Without defining Personality, Context, and Constraints, LLMs produce generic, shallow, or hallucinated answers.
- **Solution:**
  - PCT Architecture: Forces users to define Personality (Who), Context (Why), and Task (What) before submission.
  - JSON-First Optimization: Feeds user inputs to the LLM as structured JSON objects for deeper analytical capabilities.
  - Tree-of-Thought Engine: Maps out multiple logical branches and evaluates risk-weighted outcomes before synthesizing a solution.
  - Structured Deliverables: Transforms chaotic brainstorming into clean, executive-ready decision memos.
- **Impact:** Transforms 1-line prompts into deep strategic analysis; reduced strategic planning cycles from weeks to days.
- **Tech Stack:** Python, Supabase, LLM APIs, JSON Engineering

### AI Resume Enhancer — EdTech / Career Services
- Role: Product Prototyping
- Live: https://resume-ai-dev.netlify.app/
- GitHub: https://github.com/devisdev365/resume-ai
- **Problem:** Students struggle to optimize resumes for placement success, lacking insights into CV quality and job description alignment.
- **Solution:**
  - CV Analyzer: Identifies weaknesses and improvement areas
  - Placement Predictor: XGBoost ML model predicting placement success bracket with 85% accuracy
  - Resume Parser & Maker: Generates JD-aligned resume versions
- **Tech Stack:** Python, XGBoost, Generative AI API, Pandas

### Crypto Market Intelligence — FinTech / Trading
- Role: Financial Analytics Prototyping
- Live: https://btc-arbitrage-analyst.bolt.host/
- GitHub: https://github.com/devisdev365/crypto-arbitrage
- **Problem:** Can retail investors compete with institutional algorithms in identifying price inefficiencies across Indian crypto exchanges?
- **Solution:** Real-time market monitoring system tracking Bitcoin price spreads across 2 Indian crypto exchanges, with automated profit calculation after fees, taxes, and slippage. Backend pipeline built with VectorShift.
- **Impact:** Identified 15+ profitable opportunities; proved ₹10,000 investment could yield ₹500-1,500 per trade.
- **Tech Stack:** Python, Pandas, Financial Modeling, VectorShift

### QSR Brand Intelligence — Quick Service Restaurant Industry
- Role: Marketing Analytics
- Live: https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1tvOLnaMfJI8w-UVfwO6NWKvkH9vgj98B?usp=sharing
- **Problem:** QSR brands (McDonald's, Domino's, KFC) lack competitive intelligence on social media engagement strategies.
- **Solution:** Scraped 650+ Instagram posts across 3 QSR brands over 6-7 months using ParseHub. Comparative analysis with Python (Pandas, Seaborn) to evaluate engagement metrics.
- **Impact:** Identified top-performing content types, engagement rate benchmarks, optimal posting times, and competitive gaps.
- **Tech Stack:** Python, Pandas, Seaborn, ParseHub
